Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1467
Claimant:
Karen Smith
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
14 Jan 2025
First notice of loss received for a collision at an intersection where the insured was turning left and was struck in the
side by an oncoming vehicle. The claimant's attorney has written to confirm representation and asks that all contact
be directed through their office.
15 Feb 2025
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact and records the scene
as consistent with the reported left turn. Photos taken at the scene show the damage pattern and confirm several of
the details the insured described.
27 Feb 2025
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who provided a summary of injuries including a fracture to the wrist. The injury
appaers consistent in type and force with a side impact of this kind.
3 Apr 2025
Contacted the claimant, who gave the same account of the collision as in the first notice, describing the left turn and
the moment of impact. The account has not changed across each contact so far.
29 Apr 2025
Requested medical records. Initial treatment followed a usual course for this type of fracture, with care tapering off as
the claimant's condition improved.
12 Jun 2025
Medical history shows a minor strain in the same area several years ago, which healed fully with no lasting problems.
Noted for review, though it does not appear to change the current injury picture.
15 Jun 2025
Canvassed the intersection for independent witnesses. None were located, so the claim relies on the police report,
scene photos, and the parties' accounts.
11 Jul 2025
Rveiewed the vehicle file. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing in the records suggests the
damage predates the policy's effective date.
26 Aug 2025
Confirmed the driver is a member of the policyholder's household and is covered under the policy as a household
member. Coverage questions have been resolved on this point.
3 Sep 2025
Reviewing whether all of the claimed damage came from this impact. It is not yet clear how much of the treatment and
vehicle damage is attributable to this collision, and the file remains open pending a further review with the attorney.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
